---
name: Add parallel dialing
about: Dial multiple leads simultaneously
title: "[FEATURE] Parallel dialing"
labels: enhancement
---

**Description**
Allow agents to dial multiple leads at the same time and only connect when someone answers.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- [ ] Configure number of parallel lines (1-5)
- [ ] Auto-dial next lead when current call ends
- [ ] Show status of all active lines
- [ ] Prioritize leads by campaign order
- [ ] Handle busy/no-answer gracefully

**Additional context**
This is a key feature for power dialers. Most commercial solutions charge extra for this.
